note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The transcript (doctor-patient dialogue) in full.
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in the specified format (JSON or plain text as provided).

Once I have those, I will produce a concise, professional SOAP note with:
- Subjective: presenting complaints, HPI (onset/duration/progression), PMH, meds, allergies, social history.
- Objective: any exam findings or investigations mentioned.
- Assessment & Plan: for each identified issue (name of condition, applicable DDx consistent with transcript, planned investigations, treatments, and referrals).
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, any conflicts between transcript and DDx (marking “conflict noted” if applicable), and any transcript quality issues.

If any medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.” I will use American English and keep the phrasing concise and professional.
